## Step 0 — Get a Bearer Token

All subsequent calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Exchange your PAT credentials at the token endpoint (always in the POST body, never in the query string):

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID
&client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
```

Save `access_token` from the response. Rate limit: 100 requests / token / 10 seconds. If you hit a `429`, honor the `Retry-After` header.

---

## Step 1 — Create the Source

`POST /v3/sources`

Required scopes: `idn:sources:manage`  
Required user level: `ORG_ADMIN`, `SOURCE_ADMIN`, or `SOURCE_SUBADMIN`  
No experimental header needed (this is GA).

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Minimum viable body** (Active Directory example — swap `connector` and `connectorAttributes` for your target system):

```json
{
  "name": "My AD Source",
  "description": "Corporate Active Directory",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "<owner-identity-id>",
    "name": "Jane Admin"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorName": "Active Directory",
  "connectionType": "file",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "host": "ldap://dc.example.com",
    "baseDN": "DC=example,DC=com",
    "bindDN": "CN=svc_isc,OU=ServiceAccounts,DC=example,DC=com",
    "bindPassword": "secret"
  },
  "deleteThreshold": 10,
  "authoritative": false
}
```

> **CSV source?** Add `?provisionAsCsv=true` to the query string instead of setting `type` directly — that's the only way ISC will correctly configure the Delimited File connector.

The response body contains the new source's `id` — save it as `{sourceId}`.

---

## Step 2 — Kick Off Account Aggregation

`POST /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts`

Required scope: `idn:sources:manage`  
**Beta endpoint** — must include `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Optional body fields:
- `disableOptimization` (`boolean`) — set `true` to force a full (non-delta) aggregation
- `file` — only used for file-based / CSV sources; send as `multipart/form-data` instead of JSON in that case

The response contains a task/aggregation object. Pull out the aggregation `id` for the next step.

---

## Step 3 — Poll Aggregation Status

`GET /beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status`

No additional OAuth scope required beyond the bearer token.  
Still a beta endpoint, so keep `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`.

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/beta/account-aggregations/{id}/status
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-SailPoint-Experimental: true
```

Response surfaces counts of `NEW`, `CHANGED`, and `DELETED` accounts found since the last aggregation, along with how many have been processed so far. Poll until the aggregation is no longer in-progress.
